title: GhostCart Finch API: POST /api/finch/plan response (HTTP 200)
description: Products that look like the items in the photo, picked so the total stays within the budget. Names, prices, images and click_url are AISUM's, unchanged; click_url carries affiliate tracking and must be used as is. No stock, size or material information is available.

total_usd.description: Sum of items[].price_usd; never above budget_usd.

items.description: One product per item worn in the photo (a left and right shoe are one item). Items that did not fit the budget are left out.

unmatched.description: Items seen in the photo for which no similar product was found.

open_url.description: GhostCart's page, for 'see more on GhostCart'.

category.description: The item type AISUM detected, e.g. coat, pants, shoe, bag.

description.description: AISUM's description of the item in the photo, e.g. 'brown wool coat'.

click_url.description: The shop link exactly as AISUM returned it.

similarity_score.description: AISUM image-search similarity (0-1, higher is closer). Comparable only within this response.
